title: Recall Month Relief: Start Day Set by the TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member Enrollment
content:
For a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, the day the recall month relief is counted from follows the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment: where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls inside the latest-billed month, the recall month relief is counted from that effective date; where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls before the latest-billed month began, the recall month relief is counted from the first day of the month; otherwise no day of the recall month relief is counted.

The latest-billed month is the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date. The enrollment is the purchaser's own TRICARE Prime enrollment in the Active Duty Service Member tier, read by its status and effective date.

| Enrollment status | Effective date (latest-billed month June, hypothetical) | Counted from |
|---|---|---|
| active | 11 June | 11 June |
| applied | 27 May | 1 June |
| active | 4 July | no day counted |
| neither applied nor active, or none | - | no day counted |
